items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: I had various teachers, but the one to whom I give all credit was a Mrs. Stewart, because she gave me a foundation and a basic that one gets in college now.

ctx.x: Who were your teachers? Did you have many teachers?

I had various teachers, but the one to whom I give all credit was a Mrs. Stewart, because she gave me a foundation and a basic that one gets in college now. Transposition and Thoroughbass and Harmony, Theory, and all of that I had under her. And you don't get that until you advance, but she gave me a thoroughbass. So I give her all of the credit. I've had various teachers, but I give her the credit. And what's her full name? Her name is Mrs. Anna Stewart. She was a graduate of the New England Conservatory of…
Is she still in the past?
